newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.02 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.02 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis stock exchange index on Friday closed down 0.02 percent in thin trade compared with the previous day, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 487.08 points from 487.19 points on Thursday. Drinks bottler SFBT won 2.54 dinars to 89.26 dinars with only 70 shares changing hands.
Tunisian company Le Moteur was up 0.3 dinar to 34 dinars. Chemical firm Industries Chimiques du Fluor rose 0.2 dinar to 56.2.
UBCI bank advanced 0.38 dinar to 47.88 dinars.
Detergent firm SPCD fell one dinar to 34.5 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix edged lower 0.28 dinar to 34.48. Airline Tunis Air eased 0.2 dinar to 23.7 dinars.
Total volume was 711,754 dinars against 1.87 million dinars over the previous session.
